visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins outside a "SUPER ARCS" supermarket at night during a snowy winter. A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a white puffer jacket over a pink hoodie, stands in the middle of a snow-covered parking lot, waving energetically. The supermarket sign is large and brightly lit with red and yellow colors. (2) Moving inside, the camera captures various aisles of the supermarket. We see shelves packed with diverse items like fresh produce and pre-packaged goods. The lighting is bright and industrial. The woman walks through the store, gesturing towards different sections. (3) The focus shifts to the seafood section. Close-up shots display various packs of raw scallops, sweet shrimp, and sashimi platters with yellow discount stickers. The woman holds up a pack of sweet shrimp, pointing at the price label while expressing amazement with her facial expressions. (4) In the spice aisle, she examines a small bottle of multi-purpose seasoning. The background shows rows of condiments and cooking ingredients. She holds the bottle close to the camera to show the brand and price. (5) The camera follows her to the dairy section, featuring a wall of milk cartons. She points specifically to "Hokkaido Tokachi" milk. The background is filled with blue and white packaging of various milk brands in a refrigerated display. (6) Finally, she visits the bakery section where fresh bread and pastries are displayed behind glass sliding doors. She points to several items, all priced at 100 yen, showing the variety of choices available to customers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic guitar track that sets a warm and inviting tone. A female voice speaks with high energy and a friendly tone, her pitch modulating frequently as she introduces the location. There is no significant wind noise despite the snowy visual setting, suggesting a high-quality field recording or post-production cleanup. (2) As the scene transitions indoors, the BGM continues seamlessly. The woman's speech rate remains natural yet animated. A faint indoor room tone is present but doesn't interfere with the clarity of the voice. A male voice briefly chimes in from behind the camera, matching her enthusiastic energy. (3) Periodic "ding" and "pop" sound effects are synchronized with the appearance of on-screen text overlays. These effects are sharp and clean, used for emphasis. The woman's vocal intensity increases as she reacts to the low prices, exhibiting high arousal and positive valence. (4) The final segment maintains the consistent balance between the acoustic BGM and the woman's narration. The guitar continues its repetitive, happy progression. The interplay between the main speaker and the occasional incidental sounds of the store creates a realistic yet polished auditory environment.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel shopping guide, specifically highlighting the extreme affordability and variety of fresh food and groceries at a Hokkaido supermarket to attract Taiwanese viewers interested in budget-friendly Japanese travel.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is structured as a personal travel discovery vlog without explicit promotional language or sponsored calls-to-action for the store itself.
